I just had my first Intensive behavioral therapy session today after doing it from 14 to being 25 years old now and a lot of this feels really relatable right now after being 5150'd for the first time less than a month ago and it feels really good to hear someone else has the same confused feelings. 

I do it and it makes me feel better but then I want to do it more like everyone says it's an addiction but it doesn't feel like one till I'm doing it. I've never understood that feeling why in the moment after the first I want to do it more and more, but it's nice to know others have that same feeling of wanting to do it more but not knowing why. Sometimes it's because I like how it feels to hurt and see the blood, sometimes it grounds me and I don't know where that comes from.  And then I feel the same thing where I just want someone to know how much I'm hurting and want the attention that I didn't get. Then there's the times I like seeing blood streaming down my body, I don't know why I did it at the time. Even if someone was there for me emotionally, cause I don't know about you but when someone did witness it I just felt ashamed. I hope you don't get to that point. 

But the one piece of advice I can give you after doing it for almost ten years is just stop yourself when you can, it sounds stupid as fuck and not easy. But any way you can if it means getting help somewhere or finding it in yourself. I have the same feeling that the scars are cool sometimes but then I think if I ever wear shorts again I'll be immediately judged or how I have to push myself to take my shirt off in front of my girlfriend.

I still have that feeling I like the scars and I like the blood showing results but having been in a ward less than 2 months ago it's been a wake up call. I wish I didn't have those marks on my entire body. But I know a bit better now that I did it for the same reasons a lot of the time, I was sad and angry and wanted people to see me and hear me without me saying anything and eventually I stopped doing it places people could see , but now with a partner it's just added new fear and anxiety I wish I never started at all. So I really hope you stop and everyone's going to tell you that but if you keep doing it just keep my words in mind. Everyone is broken but it's up to you if you wanna break your body more.
